SUN_S1E07_P01.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E07_P01.text: People are staring. They just don't care about him.

SUN_S1E07_P01.speaker: Ada Rowan
SUN_S1E07_P01.text: You said that before they chose you.

SUN_S1E07_P01.speaker: Nessa
SUN_S1E07_P01.text: They chose me because they thought that would stop me.

SUN_S1E07_P01.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E07_P01.text: That usually has the opposite effect.

SUN_S1E07_P02.speaker: Ada Rowan
SUN_S1E07_P02.text: Her aunt trusted her with every name in this family.

SUN_S1E07_P02.speaker: Nessa
SUN_S1E07_P02.text: Aunt Mira trusted me to help. She did not appoint me as her replacement from the grave.

SUN_S1E07_P02.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E07_P02.text: Could you do it for a year?

SUN_S1E07_P02.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E07_P02.text: It is if you spend it waiting to start your own life.

SUN_S1E07_P02.speaker: Ada Rowan
SUN_S1E07_P02.text: And what would you have us do? Forget who owes what? Forget marriages? Promises?

SUN_S1E07_P02.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E07_P02.text: No. Ask who wants the work.

SUN_S1E07_P02.speaker: Nessa
SUN_S1E07_P02.text: Then they explained why every answer except me was irresponsible.

SUN_S1E07_P02.speaker: Ada Rowan
SUN_S1E07_P02.text: It is when a family is trying not to fall apart.

SUN_S1E07_P02.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E07_P02.text: And that's why this is hard.

SUN_S1E07_P03.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E07_P03.text: You have opinions about her bag.

SUN_S1E07_P03.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E07_P03.text: She has three books and one pair of socks.

SUN_S1E07_P03.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E07_P03.text: I left because I wanted to leave.

SUN_S1E07_P03.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E07_P03.text: You know I am going to ask again.

SUN_S1E07_P04.speaker: Ada Rowan
SUN_S1E07_P04.text: We are trying to be fair.

SUN_S1E07_P04.speaker: Nessa
SUN_S1E07_P04.text: You're voting on whether I have to stay.

SUN_S1E07_P04.speaker: Ada Rowan
SUN_S1E07_P04.text: We're voting on who carries the responsibility.

SUN_S1E07_P04.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E07_P04.text: Ma'am, does Nessa have to agree?

SUN_S1E07_P04.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E07_P04.text: Then I'm not sure what the vote does.

SUN_S1E07_P04.speaker: Ada Rowan
SUN_S1E07_P04.text: Then perhaps you don't understand what we owe each other.

SUN_S1E07_P04.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E07_P04.text: Probably not. But she looks like she's already answered.

SUN_S1E07_P04.speaker: Nessa
SUN_S1E07_P04.text: I love you. I'm still leaving.

SUN_S1E07_P04.speaker: Nessa
SUN_S1E07_P04.text: Then believe the second part too.

SUN_S1E07_P05.speaker: Nessa
SUN_S1E07_P05.text: You make the road sound awful.

SUN_S1E07_P05.speaker: Nessa
SUN_S1E07_P05.text: Good. I don't want another family.

SUN_S1E07_P05.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E07_P05.text: You may accidentally get one. Roads are annoying that way.

SUN_S1E07_P05.speaker: Nessa
SUN_S1E07_P05.text: And you stayed out there anyway.

SUN_S1E07_P05.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E07_P05.text: Because after a while I noticed I was happier moving than I had been staying.

SUN_S1E07_P05.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E07_P05.text: Don't make me take it back.

SUN_S1E07_P05.speaker: Nessa
SUN_S1E07_P05.text: Can I still bring one book?

SUN_S1E07_P06.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E07_P06.text: No Varnok. No Saye. No dead architect. Nobody even accused you of owing them money.

SUN_S1E07_P06.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E07_P06.text: There was a Sunforge in the middle of the yard.

SUN_S1E07_P06.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E07_P06.text: There was a goat in the middle of the yard too.

SUN_S1E07_P06.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E07_P06.text: I do. Nothing happened to him. That matters.

SUN_S1E07_P06.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E07_P06.text: I'd be happy if we stopped calling a quiet afternoon evidence.

SUN_S1E07_P06.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E07_P06.text: A quiet afternoon in your life is absolutely evidence.

SUN_S1E07_P06.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E07_P06.text: Then please don't tell the notebook.
